loi_ky_thuat_trong_ma_nguon.ten_ham_sai: bipartite_aami_ec57_matching khong phai khop cap song anh ma la tham lam theo thu tu mang. Phan vi du: gt=[0,60], det=[50,100], dung sai 50 -> tham lam TP=1; toi uu TP=2. Dao thu tu det=[100,50] -> TP=2. Ket qua phu thuoc thu tu mang.

loi_ky_thuat_trong_ma_nguon.cong_thuc_mae_sai: MAE_fHR = |so_dinh_du_doan - so_dinh_chuan| / 5 chi do SO LUONG nhip, khong do VI TRI. Phan vi du da chay: mot mo hinh du doan hoan toan ngau nhien voi F1 = 20,96% van dat MAE = 0,00 bpm.
